goal: Catch unexpected outbound network traffic and DNS queries during test runs
Keep tests hermetic to prevent test flakiness and environment data leaks
reviewability: Needs rebase and the author has been silent for over four months
agreement: General agreement on detecting test network traffic (ryanofsky, 0xB10C, Sjors, jonatack, maflcko)

Open suggestion: consider dropping traffic monitoring for clang-tidy and IWYU (ryanofsky)
